Retrieval: Direct-snippet only (Bloomberg/FT paywalled). Headline + syndicated Guardian-sourced reporting via WebSearch, 18 Jul 2026.

Bloomberg headline (15 Jul 2026): "Burnham Set to Name Shabana Mahmood as UK Chancellor, FT Says."

Reporting (attributed to senior Labour figures via The Guardian): Burnham expected to move Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood to the Treasury as Chancellor, snubbing early favourite and ally Ed Miliband amid concerns Miliband would draw criticism. Miliband more likely to become Foreign Secretary, possibly with first secretary of state status (on a par with deputy PM). Rachel Reeves, who lobbied to keep her job, is set to leave the Treasury. Burnham's team insists no final decision made; cabinet to be appointed only after he enters No 10 on Monday. Markets reported to have responded positively to Mahmood reports.

Cross-ref (CBS/ABC transition articles): Burnham said naming his team before taking office would be "premature" and cause "chaos"; will announce ministers Monday.
